1.Nc3 d5 2.f4 d4 3.Ne4 f5 4.Nf2 Nf6 5.Nf.strategy: Develops the other knight and attacks the d4 pawn for the first time. The pawn is defended only by the queen, so White makes Black decide how to support its space advantage.

Supports the d4 pawn with a pawn, so Black's space advantage rests on a solid chain rather than on the queen's defence. Black commits to a closed centre in which it has more room and White has to work with pawn breaks to open the game up.
